summary: SilverBox Corp IV filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that its units, Class A ordinary shares and warrants moved from NYSE to the OTCID Basic Market operated by OTC Markets, effective that date, with new tickers SBXUF, SBXDF and SBXWF. NYSE intends to file a Form 25 to remove the securities from listing and registration. The blank-check company states it will remain a public reporting company. No transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed. The delisting is the event; watch for the Form 25, the trust/liquidation posture and any subsequent business combination or wind-down developments.
